continuous.release_gate: No cumulative fence delay. Retain individual increases and interpret using matched starts.

matched_dirty_skip_seed_scope: Frame A uses the real original prepared geometry and each tile's exact coefficient origins, with the independent SRR running the original aggregate pass. No COPY is used for seed A, so its before/after starting counters, phase and attachments must match. Natural A+B remains above.

pointer_phase_audit.scope: Production benchmark prefix reproduced in continuous cases with exact timed packets and cycles. Matched tests use exactly the original normal UI geometry and an ordinary copy-free render pass to establish identical complete color and D24 contents, final depth validity, clock state and SDRAM/scanout phase. Matched streams have identical bytes between revisions and use a different earlier sequence range from the continuous seed's command history.
